items.title: Lessons from the Cult of the Dead Cow for today's open source defenders
items.summary: Joseph Menn joined Adrian Sanabria at the Open Source Security Summit to talk hacker history, black-box security, and why open source has an edge as AI uncovers decades of bugs.
